name: California drought
note: State water officials called 2020–2022 California's driest three years on record. Storms from December 2022 through spring 2023 ended most of the drought.

wells.source: USGS OGC API field-measurements, parameter 72019, static readings 2020-2023

snow.source: NRCS AWDB REST v1, SNOTEL WTEQ daily, median = NRCS daily median

rain.source: Open-Meteo ERA5 daily precipitation_sum (reanalysis), weekly sum to each USDM date
